authoredExperienceCoverage.method: Resolve shared source IDs against JOURNEY_TASKS, MAIN_XP_EVENTS, AREAS and CAMPAIGN_BATTLES wave experience. Native wave entries are paid once at completion; do not duplicate direct kill rewards.
authoredExperienceCoverage.future: 第3–8章 XP 是跨章等级目标预算；实际剧情/固定首清来源尚未分配。没有发放假奖励或声称后6章可自然通关。
authoredExperienceCoverage.chapter2NaturalPath: 仅来源覆盖；未录制完整第二章自然路线。

formulas.skillDamage: Production PureCombat applies skill power, shared weapon multiplier, equipped power%, authored per-target total S and segment fractions, 1+0.008*(effective main attribute-10), bounded conditional bonuses and the stored critical result. No second damage formula is used by either tool.
formulas.weapon: 1+P/(100+P/3), P>=0; approaches4. Fixed lifecycle weapons use their required-level budget, growing artifacts follow the shared native strength curve.
formulas.baseHealth: round(120+5*(combatBudgetLevel(L)-1)+4*(baseVitality-10)); gear and production modifiers apply afterwards.
formulas.enemyOrdinaryHealth: 80+30*n+1.25*n^2; n=combatBudgetLevel(authoredContentLevel)-1. Apply native archetype multiplier and round once.
formulas.critical: chance=min(.30,.05+.0012*(effectiveDexterity-10)+gearChance/100); multiplier=min(2.5,1.5+gearCritDamage/100). Same cast keeps its own critical result.
formulas.guard: Physical attacks use native guard multiplier; spells retain at least .70 while guarded. Recovery/stagger openings use the authored profile.
formulas.incomingReduction: min(.70,1-(1-A)*(1-S)*(1-W)), A=clamp(armorPercent/100,0,.55)*(physical?1:.5), S=clamp(status,-.25,.5), W=clamp(ward,0,.5). Native shields/HP then consume real damage.

resource.policy: One full initial fill; no resource reset during combat. Real finite class potions, cooldowns and support decisions.

supplies.healthPotion: max(30,30% maximum HP), limited by missing HP

forging.actualCap: min(released phase enhance budget, item cap). Planned CLI simulates shared future phase flags only inside that process.

gems.policy: Actual production open/inlay APIs and native caps; finite initial drill/crystal fixtures. No invented extra gem softcap.

model.evidenceInterpretation: Outgoing/incoming sum actual event hpLost, not nominal damage. Cross-profession total hit counts include different native segments and FIR burn ticks; misses are native accuracy-miss events, not all geometric whiffs. Source-specific rate comparisons are more meaningful than raw total hits.
model.earlyAttributePolicy: Primary attribute receives floor(2/3*legal budget), capped at80; remainder vitality then dexterity/other attributes, each capped80. This retains the old1–20 allocation exactly.
model.skillPolicy: Rank1 unlocks are free. Allocate within shared budget in fixed priority: primary, ultimate, P1, active slot1, active slot3, P2, active slot2, automatic skills. The51-point build is legal and deliberately keeps the previous priority instead of silently optimizing individual cases.
model.equipmentPolicy: Future lifecycle-full selects newest eligible same/prior-chapter item per slot with requiredLevel<=character level. Normal uses a phase epic weapon and allows eligible single-hand WAR shield; developed uses a two-handed growing artifact. Bows, staves and artifact two-handers cannot gain offhand. RingRight remains empty because these fixture groups supply ringLeft, not a fabricated second ring.
model.ownership: Declared starting equipment ownership and preparation money/materials prove production stats only. They do not prove item acquisition or economy feasibility.
model.terrain: Unobstructed flat arena; native enemy movement and attack behavior remain live in encounter/Boss measurements. Auto evade moves to a near safe point; it is movement, not invulnerability.
model.dummy: One stationary 100,000,000HP training dummy; enemy movement disabled, player displacement skills still run; forced combat engagement selects the real4/s regeneration. Thunder movement buff is not manually injected. Production Automation controls normal sword release; dummyRotation=auto.
model.plannedBoss: Existing BOSS_R2 AI/guard/movement/attacks with a one-time initial HP budget read from the official future phase boss level and multiplier. No future move set, map or reward is fabricated. This measures a reference template, not future authored content.

earlyRegression.statement: Every shared Lv1/6/10/20 row matches previous final40-level evidence exactly in duration, actual hpLost outgoing/incoming, outcome and hit count. Lv1 elite/Boss has no legal source case and is skipped, yielding864 actual rows.
earlyRegression.standingExposure: 432/432 idle cases die. Exposure has no attacks, healing, potion use or evasion; it is not attack-mode survival evidence.

actualReleasedCaps.scope: Future item-ownership fixture; production released cap6 remains authoritative. Maps3–8 stay unavailable.

plannedPhaseCaps.scope: Separate isolated CLI design simulation: phase budget records are temporarily released in memory so native forging can use8/10/10/12/12/15. JOURNEY_CHAPTERS.available, source files and browser do not change.

futureOutput.outputRatioLimit: Dummy normal/bare ratio at80 is about2.74–2.78, above the ideal1.5–2.5 bare TTK ratio. This is an output ratio, not observed future content TTK; keep as a calibration follow-up when real encounters exist.
futureOutput.growthObservation: All gear categories grow monotonically across measured stages for each profession. At80 current normal output872–1050 DPS, developed1199–1412; planned developed1325–1471. This is sustained single-target output, not a guarantee of ordinary/elite TTK in unbuilt chapters.
futureOutput.samplingCaveat: With3 deterministic seeds, planned-cap BOW developed mean is0.3% lower at40 and0.7% lower at50 than cap6 despite additive gear stats. Extra real preparation transactions change global action IDs and therefore deterministic combat critical rolls. Same release/hit counts, differing critical samples; this is not evidence that forging subtracts stats.

bossReference.scope: BOSS_R2 reference template at each future phase budget, all current actual released forging caps. No planned-phase unlock used here.
bossReference.survivalLimitation: Ranged BOW/FIR/THU take zero damage in this unobstructed melee/guard template across the future matrix. This cannot establish future chapter survival difficulty. WAR takes real damage and can use finite native healing/potions.

bowAnalysis.conclusion: BOW primary/ultimate/basic hit rate stays close to dummy, while per-hit damage falls strongly against the R2 physical front guard. This is mainly template mitigation and unavailable trap coverage, rather than lost primary casting uptime or accuracy misses. Spell guard floor and opening behavior favor FIR/THU; WAR has its own close-range opening pattern.
bowAnalysis.readOnlyCalibration: Keep early1–20 unchanged. First validate against authored future ranged/mixed encounters. If later content repeats this gap, compare a legal post20 Boss build investing new points into automatic BOW_03/BOW_04 before trap BOW_06, which production Automation skips on bosses. Only then consider future bow item strength; no blanket early skill multiplier change was made.

limitations: Only chapters1–2 are available. Eight10-level phases and future XP budgets do not unlock unfinished content.
Future ownership and finite preparation stock are declared fixtures; natural economy/source proof is separate.
The Boss reference reuses R2 guard/moves and permits extremely safe ranged kiting in open ground; future survival and encounter mechanics remain unproven.
Dummy output removes enemy movement and attacks. It cannot validate pack geometry, reaction, boss pressure or real exploration uptime.

Three deterministic seeds quantify repeatable representative variation, not a broad statistical population. Combat crit keys depend on actual action IDs; different preparation histories can shift the sample.
The fixed legal skill priority is a consistent profession comparison, not a claim of optimal51-point Boss or pack builds.
Combat maximum-rank5 and point budgets are legal; extra80-level points do not mean all skills are rank5.
No test/dev web result substitutes for real TapTap identity, platform lifecycle or device acceptance.
